items.title: Cloudflare Makes Basin Serverless Analytics Generally Available
items.summaryShort: Cloudflare Makes Basin Serverless Analytics Generally Available. Cloudflare has announced the general availability of Basin, a serverless analytics platform built on Apache Iceberg and R2 Object Storage.

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.summaryShort: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M. The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.summaryShort: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery. PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
items.summaryShort: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google. OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.
